mentions.name: ThoughtSnaps
mentions.description: A minimal tool that turns short-form writing into social cards and longer thoughts into SnapEssays—visual documents that can be shared natively on social media instead of linking to a blog post. Users pick a color theme, pick a template, and export, with no drag-and-drop, layers, or fuss. Built with SvelteKit on the frontend and Go/Fiber on the backend, including OAuth and templates, with an MCP server in progress so AI assistants can generate and export cards directly.
mentions.problem: Sharing links to blog posts gets buried by social media algorithms, so longer and short-form thoughts need to be shareable as native visual content instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building ThoughtSnaps (https://www.thoughtsnaps.app/),  a minimal tool that turns short-form writing into social cards, and longer thoughts into SnapEssays:  visual documents you can share natively instead of linking to a blog post the algorithm will bury.
